primaryResearch.observed: EMAIL event selection and callback JSON fields/headers are configurable. Queued/accepted/delivered/opened/failed are different events. Its requestId description depicts a timestamp while the sample depicts a UUID; exact account identifier semantics remain required.

WhatsApp distinguishes outbound request and delivery reports, exposes configurable fields/headers, and identifies duplicate event/WAMID delivery. Its auto-pause section excludes HTTP429 and describes up to five retries for 5xx/429/temporary failures.

General Webhook(New) guidance describes an eight-second callback response budget, up to four retries and pausing for 4xx/5xx. The retry/pause description differs from the WhatsApp page; verify selected account/channel behavior instead of choosing one as a proved contract.
